Name: Ahimelech
Summary: Ahimelech was the priest whose house David came to while fleeing Saul, as the title of Psalm 52 records — an act of mercy that cost Ahimelech his life.
KeyStory: When David fled to Nob, Ahimelech gave him bread and a sword; Doeg reported it to Saul, and Ahimelech and the priests of Nob were put to death.
LifeLesson: Ahimelech shows costly kindness — he helped God's anointed without knowing the price, and paid it.
